description: Minimal valid pacs.009 Financial Institution Credit Transfer with only required elements. Demonstrates bank-to-bank institutional transfer with minimal data.
test_coverage: Required group header elements (MsgId, CreDtTm, NbOfTxs, TtlIntrBkSttlmAmt, IntrBkSttlmDt, InstgAgt, InstdAgt)
Required transaction elements (PmtId with InstrId and EndToEndId)
Required agent fields (InstgAgt, InstdAgt, Cdtr, CdtrAgt)
business_rules_expected_to_pass: PACS009-DT01: Settlement date not in past
PACS009-GH02: Transaction count consistency (1 CdtTrfTxInf, NbOfTxs=1)
notes: This minimal message demonstrates the bare minimum required for a valid pacs.009 message. Deutsche Bank (DEUTDEFF) is instructing BNP Paribas (BNPAFRPP) to transfer EUR 1,000. The creditor is the beneficiary institution (BNPAFRPP itself). No optional elements like payment type info, charges, intermediaries, or additional party details are included.
